eval_results.prompt: We are building an AI devtools startup called 'Vortex'. Create a full brand visual identity strategy and core metaphor.

expectations.text: Defines Mission, Vision, and Values answering the three fundamental brand questions
expectations.evidence: Verified in brand-identity-design Stage 1: Brand Soul (Mission, Vision, Values fundamental questions defined).

expectations.text: Establishes a core creative concept or metaphor ('Polaris')
expectations.evidence: Verified in brand-identity-design Stage 2 & 3: Core Creative Concept ('Polaris') & Core Metaphor.

expectations.text: Defines style quadrant positioning (e.g. Modern vs Classic, Human vs Tech)
expectations.evidence: Verified in brand-identity-design Stage 2: Style Quadrant Positioning (Classic<->Modern, Human<->Tech).

expectations.text: Outlines Foundation Layer (Logo clear space, Color strategy, Typography hierarchy, Grid system)
expectations.evidence: Verified in brand-identity-design Stage 4: Foundation Layer (Logo, Color System with WCAG, Typography, Grid).

expectations.text: Includes digital touchpoints (hero website, IDE plugin badge, dev docs)
expectations.evidence: Verified in brand-identity-design Stage 5: Multi-Touchpoint Validation (Digital Hero, Print, Motion).

expectations.text: 提炼东方美学核心隐喻与视觉调性（如草木灵气、极简留白）

expectations.text: 规划多触点应用规范（茶饮杯包装、门店招牌、线上小程序、周边物料）
